explanation: They contain the same texts, divided differently. The Hebrew Bible counts the twelve minor prophets as one book, and Samuel, Kings, Chronicles and Ezra-Nehemiah as one book each.
learnMore: Development of the Hebrew Bible canon

claims.text: The Hebrew Bible (Tanakh) is traditionally counted as 24 books.
The Protestant Old Testament has 39 books.
The Hebrew Bible and the Protestant Old Testament contain the same texts, divided and ordered differently.
The Hebrew Bible counts the twelve minor prophets as one book, and Samuel, Kings, Chronicles and Ezra-Nehemiah as one book each.
